svg.text: Thara Hospitals patient portal pilot: canonical architecture
Region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Numbered components are built one at a time; each lab lights up the components it adds.
taught, not built in the pilot
demonstrated by the lecturer, or concept only
The NAT gateway (7), partner VPC (9) and load balancer (12) exist only during their lab: they bill by the hour.
